name: ContextToolbar
intent: Compact contextual toolbar with icon/title, status, actions, density, and accessible responsive overflow in atomic flex groups.
when: A surface needs a compact context label/status and a small set of actions
Action and identity clusters must remain aligned and atomic at narrow widths
whenNot: A route needs avatar, descriptive metadata, peer navigation, and priority action hierarchy -> use PageContentHeader
A persistent application shell top bar -> use CoreAppTopBar

chooseOver.because: ContextToolbar supplies Core context/title/status semantics and responsive action overflow rather than only primitive toolbar behavior.
ContextToolbar is a compact surface-local context row; PageContentHeader owns route identity, navigation, and workflow action hierarchy.

states.overflow: Actions beyond maxVisibleActions appear in an accessible menu

allowedPlacement: Above a route-local workspace, canvas, table, or panel
forbiddenPlacement: As the persistent application shell top bar

commonMistakes.mistake: Applying gap without flex or grid to toolbar wrappers
commonMistakes.symptom: The intended spacing is inactive and action groups crowd the title
commonMistakes.fix: Use ContextToolbar slots; its title and action groups are flex, centered, and marked atomic.
commonMistakes.avoidOverride: Do not apply gap utilities to non-flex/non-grid toolbar wrappers.

minimalExample: <ContextToolbar leadingIcon={<Map />} title="Live map" status={<Badge>Online</Badge>} actions={[{id: "filter", label: "Filter", onSelect: openFilters}]} />

evaluationCriteria.check: Title/status/actions use the artifact slots instead of an ad hoc toolbar.
At desktop and 820px, atomic groups neither overlap nor split and icon actions remain labeled.

ownership.expectedWrapper: Direct contextual-surface child with no duplicate background, divider, or padding wrapper.

lineage.confidence: high — API and responsive ownership authored from held-out experiment
